items.description:
Owner: auditctl (tracked in agentops; auditctl has no local sprintctl, per the #2063 precedent).

auditctl main carries two landed changes that are inert until released: c094ad4 binds the terminal-reason contract to the dispatch.exit event type rather than to its retired first writer's source name, and fb8ee82 removes require_artifacts_root, a dead function stating a requirement dropped in 0.1.4. The SubagentStop hook writes dispatch.exit through the installed CLI, so neither takes effect until a release is installed.

The blocker is not a test failure. tests/test_verification_contracts.py::test_central_result_digest_matches_the_packaged_implementation_tree asserts that one named packet, verification/results/central-observation-ingest-item-1201.json, records an implementation_sha equal to the packaged tree. pyproject.toml is inside CENTRAL_IMPLEMENTATION_PATHS, so every version bump falsifies it and the only route back to green is to rewrite that packet.

That packet is not a digest. It is an observation of one run, carrying its own claims, counterexamples, execution bounds and a note about a timezone defect found in the first adapter read-path run. Restamping its implementation_sha makes that narrative describe a tree it was never run against. auditctl's own boundary rule settles it without an owner decision: a ledger records what was observed and never states what should be. The 0.1.6 release restamped, so item-1201 already asserts a run it did not have.

Scope: (1) change the digest assertion to require that SOME result for this context matches the packaged tree, preserving the guarantee that the shipped tree is verified while letting observations accumulate; (2) add a new result packet named for this item, recording the run actually performed, leaving item-1201 unchanged; (3) bump to 0.1.7 and release.

Verification: run the central verification per docs/operations/running-the-central-verification.md, with PostgreSQL realized through nix shell. Measured on 2026-08-30 at fb8ee82: 143 passed, 1 skipped, and 144 passed with the 0.1.7 wheel present.

Note for a later reader: item ids 1201, 1202 and 1207 named by the other result filenames resolve in no repo scope reachable today. Only 2063 does. Those references are dangling and are not repaired here.
items.title: Re-verify and release auditctl 0.1.7 without restamping an observation

recent_decisions.detail: docs/contracts/authority-uuid-and-principal-binding.md. Measured against vuoro-service 1b1ac48 and sprintctl 0.3.4: work-path isolation is real (app.py:369 gates every repo_scoped op on authorizes_repo) but compares human-readable names from a client-supplied repo_id; the authority UUID is checked by nothing served, since authority.py:465 only compares when the legacy direct-PG store has a value. homelab-analytics minted its own UUID on 2026-08-29 and was believed. ALL_REPOS='*' authorizes repositories that do not exist yet. Contract requires the UUID be issued and recorded server-side, not asserted; removes '*' from the auth path; seven required-rejection cases including rename-preserves-grants. Migration ratifies the 8 existing UUIDs explicitly, dual-reads during transition, and reports manifest drift rather than silently repairing it.
recent_decisions.summary: Contract written: one immutable issued authority UUID, principal bound to UUIDs not names, caller-supplied repo id is a routing hint only

recent_events.detail: hostproto: the GitHub repository was archived read-only on 2026-08-28 and the work split into six successors (hostproto-a2a-worker, -dap-core, -dap-debugpy, -dap-delve, -mcp-playwright, -semantics). None of the six has a dispatch manifest, a skills directory, or a work-authority marker, so there is no 'current native hostproto path' to run -- the path the baseline names was retired the day before this item was written. scribectl: reads served correctly (sprint #439 visible, repo marker resolves) but its manifest is schema_version 1, adoption observable, with no authority_repo_uuid and a non-UUID repo_id, so every authority command (item status, item done, sprint close) is refused client-side by _authority_repo_uuid() before anything is sent -- the same wall homelab-analytics hit on 2026-08-29 and closed by minting one. A NARROW run in scribectl would therefore terminate at the close step, and 'mint an authority UUID' would be counted as an operator action, which is a real baseline datum but not the one this item intends. Re-scoping needed: either (a) run the baseline in scribectl after minting its UUID and record that mint as the first measured operator action, or (b) replace the hostproto half with one named successor repo, onboarded first, and measure the onboarding itself. Evidence: docs/assessments/dispatch-manifest-classification-2026-08-29.md.
recent_events.summary: Both native paths this baseline measures are unrunnable as specified: the hostproto path no longer exists, and scribectl cannot complete a work cycle

Limitation stated: process loss, not host loss; the credential outside any repo survived because the filesystem did.

recent_events.detail:
auditctl main af96357, pushed and verified at the canonical remote.

Derived rather than escalated. The question 'restamp the existing verification result or produce a new one' was raised as an owner call and should not have been: auditctl's own boundary rule settles it -- a ledger records what was observed and never states what should be -- so an observation is never rewritten. The upstream question that IS open is the one the vuoro direction doc already lists under open architecture decisions: where EvidenceSet and Decision are canonically stored. verification/results/ and acceptance-lab's campaigns/ are both standing in for a durable evidence record with no declared home, which is why each improvises whether it is a record or a build output.

Root cause of the block, measured: pyproject.toml is inside CENTRAL_IMPLEMENTATION_PATHS, so a version bump changes the digest of an implementation that did not change. git diff 5f45f12..HEAD over all seven digested paths is empty; the sole difference is the version literal. The digest assertion named one packet, so the only route back to green was to falsify it. It now requires that SOME result for the context was observed against the packaged tree -- guarantee kept, singularity dropped.

Evidence, at the artifact rather than the report:
- installed __version__ 0.1.7 in ~/.local/share/uv/tools/auditctl/lib/python3.12/site-packages/
- validate_dispatch_exit_metadata present in the installed tree; require_artifacts_root absent
- the installed CLI rejects terminal_reason 'ran-out-of-vibes' with the seven safe codes, rejects a dispatch.exit carrying no terminal_reason, and accepts 'usage-limit' -- run in a disposable repo, since declared is not invoked and invoked is not evidenced
- central verification 144 passed / 0 failed, PostgreSQL 18.6 via nix shell

Not done, and not blocking: devbox is not upgraded (the 0.1.6 handover found it two versions behind, so it should be checked rather than assumed), and the composition repin / vuoro-service / cluster roll chain is untouched -- this release changes the local publisher path only, and the served adapter is unaffected.

Dangling references left as found: result filenames name items 1201, 1202 and 1207, none of which resolve in any repo scope reachable today. Only 2063 does.
recent_events.summary: 0.1.7 released and verified at the installed artifact; item-1201 left untouched
